text: Meta TMO uses pressure feedback to offload colder memory to compressed memory or storage. This implementation is a bounded adaptation, not a reproduction of TMO. Avoid proactive offloading during high stalls; evaluate improvement and stop unsuccessful policies.

memory.reclaim requests proactive reclaim in one cgroup. swappiness=0 prefers file-backed reclaim; swappiness=100 allows anonymous memory to be swapped. Reclaim may return EAGAIN after partial progress. Only a verified dedicated app cgroup with writable delegated interface is eligible. Never reclaim protected app groups.

zswap trades CPU time for reduced swap I/O using compressed RAM in front of backing swap. zram provides compressed RAM block devices. Do not stack or replace existing compression setups automatically; do not swapoff a heavily used disk swap to enable compression.

PSI measures time stalled on resources. Large swap occupancy alone does not prove current thrashing. Prefer bounded non-terminating reclaim and inactive browser discard; use app termination as a later step. Do not kill session services or ambiguous JVMs. Never use drop_caches as a routine memory fix.

Discarding unloads a tab and revisiting reloads it. Active tabs cannot be discarded. Closing a standalone web app is a distinct destructive action. Recheck protection and identity immediately before execution.
